name: ROOFTOP GARDEN PLATFORM
text: A reinforced metal deck serves as a high-
altitude farm, bordered by safety railings.
Makeshift planters burst with colorful crops
under the shadow of tattered solar awnings.

name: LOWER DECK SECTION
text: A descending walkway leads to another tier of
the rooftop complex. Sturdy metal stairs
provide access between the multi-level
agricultural setup.

name: LOWER PLANTER BOX
text: A large, soil-filled container occupies the
lower platform, enclosed by a low wooden rim.
It's densely packed with a variety of root
vegetables and leafy greens.

name: ROOT VEGETABLE CROP
text: Bright orange carrots and plump purple turnips
push up through the dark soil of the planter
box. The leafy tops are vibrant and healthy, a
testament to careful tending.

name: IRRIGATION FEED SYSTEM
text: A small, boxy mechanical unit sits near the
planters, connected by a network of thin gray
pipes. It hums softly, regulating the flow of
water or nutrients to the upper garden beds.

name: MIXED PRODUCE BED
text: A wooden planter is neatly organized into
rows, yielding a colorful harvest. Plump
radishes, orange carrots, and round cabbages
thrive despite the smoggy skyline behind them.

name: WATER STORAGE CYLINDERS
text: A pair of dull metal tanks rest on the lower
platform, their surfaces streaked with grime.
They likely hold a reserve of purified water
essential for the crops' survival.

name: GLOWING PLANT BED
text: A narrow planter box holds a row of unusual,
luminescent flora. The pale blue bulbs emit a
soft, steady glow that cuts through the
surrounding rust and shadow.
